coverage: Partial assertions only; permanent manual checklist remains unchecked.

navigation-settings-back.assertions: Settings opens through the accessible avatar and System Back restores Chats.

navigation-account-empty.assertions: Carol has no Alice conversation; returning to Alice restores her group.

conversation-selection-cancel.assertions: Long-press message actions can be dismissed without removing the selected message.

conversation-landscape.assertions: Conversation history stays accessible across landscape and portrait rotation.

settings-profile-keys.assertions: Private key remains concealed when opening and leaving Profile Keys; no reveal or clipboard export.

navigation-profile-edit-cancel.assertions: Back discards an edited profile name without publishing it.

preferences-dark.assertions: Dark selection survives leaving/reopening Appearance; fixture verifies the selected theme.

preferences-font-large.assertions: Large font selection remains displayed after returning to Appearance; fixture verifies the selected font scale.

preferences-font-cancel.assertions: System Back dismisses the font-size picker and retains the default choice.

preferences-language-cancel.assertions: Language picker is reachable and Back returns to Appearance without a language change.

advanced-custom-emoji.assertions: Custom emoji management opens with photo/file actions and Back returns to Appearance.

groups-details-return.assertions: Conversation header opens real group details and Back restores its history.

groups-members.assertions: Native group roster displays both generated members.

groups-relays.assertions: Group relay details can be opened and dismissed without editing or publishing relay configuration.

creation-group-back.assertions: Group recipient picker Back restores New Message.

creation-group-setup-cancel.assertions: An entered group name can be canceled before native submission.

creation-group-name-retained.assertions: Unsubmitted setup name survives Back to the recipient picker and return.

actions-edit-cancel.assertions: Editing an outgoing fixture message can be canceled with its original text retained.

actions-forward-cancel.assertions: Forward destination picker opens then cancels without sending.

actions-selection-back.assertions: Explicit Select mode can be dismissed while keeping the transcript.

actions-info-back.assertions: Message information opens and Back restores its source transcript.

groups-mute-cancel.assertions: Mute duration dialog cancels without activating a mute.

groups-retention-cancel.assertions: Disappearing-message picker opens and cancels before a native mutation.

groups-edit-cancel.assertions: Admin group editor opens and cancels with the existing group title retained.

groups-notifications-back.assertions: Conversation notification settings opens through group details and Back restores that group.

polls-cancel.assertions: Cancel a typed poll draft without publishing it.

polls-question-required.assertions: Empty question submission stays in the dialog with its inline validation error.

polls-two-options-required.assertions: One nonempty option is rejected without closing the draft.

polls-duplicate-options.assertions: Case-equivalent options show the duplicate validation error.

polls-question-boundary.assertions: A 1025-byte question is rejected at the 1024-byte limit.

polls-option-boundary.assertions: A 257-byte option is rejected at the 256-byte limit.

polls-add-remove-option.assertions: Add and remove a third option while retaining the two required option fields.

polls-custom-zero.assertions: Custom zero duration is rejected inline instead of starting a deadline.

folders-create-reopen.assertions: Save a named folder, reopen its editor and retain the saved name.

folders-empty-name.assertions: Empty name keeps Save disabled and Back leaves without a discard prompt.

folders-whitespace-name.assertions: Whitespace name keeps Save disabled; explicit discard leaves no custom folder.

folders-keep-editing.assertions: Keep Editing preserves an unsaved name; subsequent explicit discard removes the draft.

folders-delete-cancel.assertions: Cancel the folder-specific delete confirmation and retain the saved folder.

folders-delete-confirm.assertions: Confirm deletion of the generated custom folder; fixture checks it was removed.

preferences-light.assertions: Light theme survives leaving and reopening Appearance; fixture checks the state projection.

preferences-amoled.assertions: AMOLED theme survives leaving and reopening Appearance; fixture checks the state projection.

nested-action-color.assertions: Action-color controls and preview open, then Back returns to Appearance without committing a draft.

nested-bubble-colors.assertions: Bubble-color editor opens its sent-message controls and preview, then Back returns to Appearance.

nested-blocked-empty.assertions: Fresh native account shows the explicit empty block list; Back returns to Privacy.

nested-diagnostics.assertions: Sharing choices open and dismiss without granting usage or diagnostic sharing.

nested-default-retention.assertions: Default retention picker opens and cancels without changing new-chat policy.

nested-bug-report.assertions: Bug-report destination and opening action are visible; Back returns to Help without opening GitHub.

nested-share-connect.assertions: Active-profile header opens its public QR card and Back restores Settings without sharing.

nested-donate.assertions: Donate opens its action and returns without launching a browser or payment flow.

reader-back.assertions: Expanded Markdown reader opens its generated heading and returns to the source conversation.

reader-scroll-end.assertions: Reader scroll reaches the actual end of a long native message before returning.

reader-rotation.assertions: Expanded reader remains open through landscape and portrait configuration changes.

reader-actions-cancel.assertions: Reader action menu cancels back to the same expanded message without copying.

reader-reply-cancel.assertions: Reply from the expanded message creates a reply target; cancel removes that target without sending.

reader-links-library.assertions: A genuine native text link exposes the shared Links destination; Back restores its group without browser navigation.

composer-expand-collapse.assertions: Expand and collapse the composer without dropping an unsent native draft.

composer-expanded-rotation.assertions: Expanded draft text survives landscape and portrait rotation.

composer-expanded-keyboard-back.assertions: Keyboard Back preserves the expanded draft and its collapse control.

composer-expanded-route-return.assertions: Expanded-to-compact draft survives leaving and reopening the conversation.

developer-unlock.assertions: Seven version taps reveal Developer Tools with its development warning; Back returns to About.

developer-mode-off.assertions: Turning developer mode off hides debugging controls while leaving Key Packages available.

developer-key-packages.assertions: Key Packages opens its real native-backed content and Back restores Developer Tools; no package is published.

developer-quarantine.assertions: Quarantined Groups opens its real content and Back restores Developer Tools; no recovery mutation is submitted.

developer-diagnostics.assertions: Diagnostics opens Events and actions and Back restores Developer Tools.

developer-diagnostics-actions.assertions: Opening and dismissing Diagnostics actions retains Events without clearing or submitting native work.

developer-diagnostics-health.assertions: Health shows its controls; cancelling returns to Events without sending a diagnostic message.

support-entry-back.assertions: Support contact information is displayed; Back returns to Settings without contacting Support.

support-relay-guidance.assertions: The loopback-only profile needs public receiving relays; Support offers relay guidance and cannot start a support chat.

support-relays-back.assertions: Support receiving-relay guidance opens Relays and Back returns to Support without publishing or starting a chat.

ballots-open-back.assertions: Published poll displays its question, options and single-choice type; Back does not cast a vote.

ballots-single-vote.assertions: UI selection casts one Tea vote; both real native accounts must show one participant and matching tally.

ballots-change-vote.assertions: Replacing Tea with Coffee retains one voter and transfers the tally, verified on both native accounts.

ballots-multiple-vote.assertions: Multiple choice retains Tea and Coffee for one voter; both native accounts must agree on options and tally.

ballots-votes-sheet-back.assertions: View votes shows the actual Alice voter and chosen Tea option; Back returns to the poll without changing the native tally.

ballots-publish.assertions: UI publishes a valid two-option poll; both native accounts must receive exactly one matching published poll without a vote.

profiles-member-back.assertions: Bob member profile shows native identity and private-detail entry; Back restores the same group details.

profiles-private-cancel.assertions: Cancelling private nickname and notes leaves Bob unchanged and discards the unsaved values on reopen.

profiles-private-rotation.assertions: Private nickname and notes survive Activity rotation while editing, then explicit Cancel discards them.

profiles-add-group-back.assertions: The Add-to-group picker can be dismissed without changing existing membership.

profiles-shared-groups.assertions: Groups in Common shows the actual generated shared group and Back restores Bob profile.

profiles-admin-picker-back.assertions: The group admin picker is reachable for Alice and Back cancels without promoting Bob.

profiles-start-group-back.assertions: Start group uses Bob as the intended recipient; Back leaves the unsubmitted setup without creating a group.

chats-menu-back.assertions: Back cancels the row menu and preserves the generated conversation.

chats-delete-cancel.assertions: Cancel dismisses device-local deletion confirmation and preserves accessible history.

chats-folder-cancel.assertions: Cancelling Add-to-folder with no custom folders does not create a folder or remove the chat.

chats-select-back.assertions: Back leaves selection mode and preserves the selected chat.

chats-bulk-delete-cancel.assertions: Cancel from selection deletion preserves the row and permits normal navigation.

chatstate-pin.assertions: Pin changes the row command to Unpin and the real native row is pinned.

chatstate-pin-round-trip.assertions: Pin then Unpin restores the initial native row state without changing the peer row.

chatstate-delete-confirm.assertions: Confirmed local deletion removes only Alice row while Bob retains his actual group.

consent-default-close.assertions: Closing untouched default-off choices reaches Chats and native telemetry is declined with logging still off.

consent-system-back.assertions: System Back dismisses the first-launch choice sheet and records decline without enabling logging.

consent-usage-details.assertions: Usage disclosure expands and collapses without recording consent or enabling either choice.

consent-logs-details.assertions: Log disclosure is readable and can collapse while consent remains undecided and logging off.

consent-details-independent.assertions: Collapsing usage disclosure leaves diagnostic-log disclosure expanded without granting collection.

consent-details-rotation.assertions: Usage disclosure stays expanded across landscape and portrait configuration changes without recording consent.

consent-log-confirm-cancel.assertions: Enabling diagnostic logs requires the explicit upload disclosure; Cancel leaves native logging off and consent undecided.

keys-empty.assertions: Empty passwords disable both encrypted-backup destinations.

keys-minimum-boundary.assertions: Matching twelve-character passwords enable both destinations without exporting.

keys-mismatch.assertions: Different valid-length passwords cannot request a backup.

keys-cancel-clears.assertions: Cancel erases valid passphrases before the next dialog opens.

keys-back-clears.assertions: System Back dismisses and clears passphrases without exporting.

keys-correct-mismatch.assertions: Correcting confirmation enables both destinations and clears mismatch feedback.

search-date-cancel.assertions: Staging Today then cancelling the date picker leaves no applied date filter.

search-custom-start-cancel.assertions: Cancelling the custom-range start picker restores presets without applying a range.

search-custom-end-cancel.assertions: Advancing a selected start date then cancelling the end picker does not commit a partial range.

search-types-back.assertions: Chat-type filter dialog exposes both categories and Back closes the dialog before search.

search-content-back.assertions: Content filter dialog opens and Back returns to the same search without a selection.

search-date-today.assertions: Today produces its exact active date chip; Clear all removes it.

search-date-week.assertions: Last 7 days produces its exact active date chip; Clear all removes it.

search-date-month.assertions: Last 30 days produces its exact active date chip; Clear all removes it.

notifications-deny.assertions: Deny the actual Android notification prompt and reach Chats with native permission denied.

notifications-grant.assertions: Grant the actual Android notification prompt and verify the system permission is granted.

notifications-back.assertions: Back dismisses the notification request without granting permission.

notifications-deny-settings.assertions: Settings Notifications opens after system denial without silently granting permission.

actions-delete-cancel.assertions: Outgoing message deletion offers local/everyone choices; Cancel dismisses confirmation and retains the original message.

actions-delete-back.assertions: Outgoing message deletion offers local/everyone choices; Android Back dismisses confirmation and retains the original message.

actions-delete-rotate.assertions: Outgoing message deletion offers local/everyone choices; landscape/portrait configuration changes and Cancel dismisses confirmation and retains the original message.

actions-batch-delete-cancel.assertions: Select one real message, open batch-delete confirmation, cancel, leave selection, and retain its transcript.

reports-back.assertions: Incoming-message reporting states who receives it, offers a send action, and Android Back retains the transcript without submission.

reports-other-cancel.assertions: The final reason remains selectable after scrolling; closing reporting retains the incoming message.

reports-explanation-cancel.assertions: Report explanation input accepts disposable text; dismissing the keyboard and sheet returns to the incoming message without submission.

reports-rotation-cancel.assertions: Reporting remains reachable through landscape/portrait configuration changes and can be canceled without sending.

acquisition-camera-deny.assertions: Open real Camera acquisition, deny the request, retain the transcript without selecting or sending media. Verify Android CAMERA remains denied.

acquisition-camera-back.assertions: Open real Camera acquisition, cancel with Android Back, retain the transcript without selecting or sending media. Verify Android CAMERA remains denied.

acquisition-gallery-cancel.assertions: Open real Photos and videos acquisition, cancel with Android Back, retain the transcript without selecting or sending media.

acquisition-document-cancel.assertions: Open real Files acquisition, cancel with Android Back, retain the transcript without selecting or sending media.

keys-rotation-cancel.assertions: Encrypted-backup passphrase dialog remains usable during handled landscape/portrait changes; explicit Cancel clears its fields on reopen and the raw key remains hidden.

speech-rate-back.assertions: The rate chooser lists system/custom choices; Android Back dismisses it to Read Aloud.

speech-custom-cancel.assertions: Custom rate input is dismissed by Cancel without applying a value.

speech-custom-back.assertions: The custom rate dialog dismisses after the keyboard is hidden and Android Back is pressed.

speech-custom-reopen.assertions: An unapplied custom rate is discarded when the dialog is cancelled and reopened.

speech-custom-empty.assertions: Unapplied custom rate '' cannot close the dialog after Apply; the range error remains visible.

speech-custom-zero.assertions: Unapplied custom rate '0' cannot close the dialog after Apply; the range error remains visible.

speech-custom-below-min.assertions: Unapplied custom rate '0.09' cannot close the dialog after Apply; the range error remains visible.

speech-custom-above-max.assertions: Unapplied custom rate '10.01' cannot close the dialog after Apply; the range error remains visible.

speech-custom-minimum-cancel.assertions: The exact 0.1 rate boundary is editable; Cancel leaves the destination intact. No applied-rate or audio proof is claimed.

speech-custom-maximum-cancel.assertions: The exact 10.0 rate boundary is editable; Cancel leaves the destination intact. No applied-rate or audio proof is claimed.

speech-custom-rotation-cancel.assertions: Custom-rate dialog and entered value remain accessible through handled orientation changes, then Cancel dismisses it.

speech-rate-return.assertions: After dismissing the rate chooser, toolbar Back returns through Settings to Chats.

dictation-provider-back.assertions: The actual provider chooser exposes Automatic and dismisses without choosing an external provider; handled rotation stays navigable.

dictation-provider-rotation.assertions: The actual provider chooser exposes Automatic and dismisses without choosing an external provider; handled rotation stays navigable.

dictation-finish-back.assertions: The automatic-completion chooser includes manual Paste or Send and dismisses without changing the option.

dictation-provider-reopen.assertions: A cancelled provider chooser can be opened again; Automatic remains available.

speech-custom-overflow.assertions: Malformed/overflow rate input cannot dismiss the custom dialog after Apply; the range error is visible and Cancel returns to Read Aloud.
